Dear Ms. Arisha Via Gong,
Customer Success Manager of Encord,

Thank you very much for taking the time to meet with me yesterday and 
for your follow-up email. I truly appreciate your insights and the clarity you 
provided during our discussion.
Following our conversation and subsequent internal review, I would like 
to confirm the details below and kindly seek your agreement on the proposed 
arrangement. I believe this aligns with your understanding, though my email is 
a bit longer.

Completed Contracts and Payments:
2024/06/10 – 2025/06/09 (12 months): Total $50,000 (JPY 8,039,000)
2025/06/10 – 2026/02/28 (9 months): Total $37,500 (JPY 5,467,875)

However, regarding the remaining three months of the current term, 
as previously discussed and agreed upon with Mr. Fujimura, Director of R&D, 
at the time of contract initiation, I would like to request the following:

We plan to commence service usage and payment after confirmation of 
the Japanese government subsidy.
Based on current projections, we anticipate starting in May for a three-month 
period, with contract-related discussions beginning in April 2026.
We kindly ask to avoid any service usage or payment obligations in March 
and April 2026.

may be challenging depending on the subsidy amount, please be assured 
that we will make every effort to proceed positively and explore options for an extended engagement if feasible.

I hope this arrangement can be accommodated, and I greatly appreciate your understanding and flexibility. Should you require any additional information or documentation from our side, please do not hesitate to let me know.
Thank you once again for your kind cooperation and support.

Best regards,

subject: Re: AWL + Encord
text:
Dear Arisha,

First, please accept my apologies for the delay in responding.
Thank you very much for your message and for your kind and detailed explanation.

As you confirmed, our request refers to a full suspension of both platform usage and 
payment obligations for the two months of March and April 2026. 
We will not be using the service during this period.
Additionally, I would like to clarify one point regarding user management. 
Currently, the system has the following two users registered:
dataimporter11+awl@gmail.com
guest+awl@encord.com
These accounts were added by Encord to assist with initial configuration at the start of the project. 
As they were not created by us, we are unable to manage or modify their access rights. 
Please note that we cannot disable these accounts on our side, even during the service suspension period.

Regarding the remaining three months of service, we are expecting to proceed with usage in 
May, June, and July 2026 (starting around May 1st). However, depending on the government subsidy 
approval schedule, the actual usage period may shift slightly—for example, to June, July, and August.
